Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side.

Dense fitted sections — BLAZING glossy black onyx surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID creamy-white concentric banding flowing through every section, with tiny inlaid gemstones set along the joints, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Everywhere else, including her bust, the banded onyx is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
#1: Pose: both hands on her waist, elbows flared out to the sides, chin lifted — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
